manifest.method: After mint, count the tiktoken units in each complete Ainglish report minus its complete careful-English report for all three source-pinned encodings; average the ten paired deltas per encoding and report the maximum encoding mean.
manifest.selection: Ten prospective reports frozen without tokenizer exposure: five per registered form; the by-accident controls preserve the source's four 'by accident' to one 'by mistake' mixture.
manifest.scope: Current tiktoken 0.14.0 encodings only. This deterministic cost result does not measure comprehension, adoption, or future Ainglish-trained tokenizers.

token_derivation.scope: Recounted submitted text and arithmetic only; not comparator adequacy, independent replication, comprehension, or future-trained efficiency.
